request: Locally merge PR #7, validate affected application and tools, remove Android 2.7.81 preparation whitelist.

scope.primary_worktree: Eight pre-existing Ark_emulator deletions are outside this merge and preserved.

comparison_review.baseline: local main at the recorded base; fetched origin/main matched that commit at integration start
constraints_preserved: Core guarded capture remains fail closed; optional fields require their accepted frame to match the core frame.
Discovery bytes do not become accepted current detail data and are cleared after each round.
Process birth, battle ownership, class identity, native instruction shapes, policy generation and immutable publication remain checked.
Qt owns presentation; background readers own game IO. Inactive frontend retires private consumers while backend/public WS remain independent.
intentional_semantics: Requested change: package version strings no longer control preparation, engine retries or transport rebind. Live layout and ownership validation remain mandatory.
PR adds stable lifecycle readiness for paused battles and explicit new-instance transitions rather than requiring clock advancement.
PR retains explicitly labelled last_known display values until source invalidation. These retain original frame evidence; failure cannot promote them to current.
Coordinated core and optional execution does not imply a globally atomic transaction; separate guards and aggregation frame checks still apply.
integration_repairs: Bind Qt close retry timer to the QObject owner so destroyed windows cannot receive delayed callbacks.
Update integration fixtures for lifecycle generations, source runtime observations, dependent field policy and added publication topics.
Update effect-frame test data lookup to the production resolver so available game_data catalogs are tested rather than skipped.
Add failure-oriented layout, lifecycle, capture ownership, JSON fallback, presentation and native protocol regression coverage.
